replies.author: hasl
replies.body: Woah, 'making' an Anti-Cheat isn't a quick and easy project, do you even know how long it took for GCheat, and much it's worth? The current one is useless and is the cause of the nametag bug, so it should be removed. Javi's detectors are a great help and are close enough to an Anti-Cheat except it only reports them, not auto-bans.
